outputs.studyReference: ILLUSTRATIVE conductor duty screening example only
limitations: One physical conductor only; multiple parallel runs need independently verified fault current distribution
Entered k is NOT derived or verified: material, insulation, initial and maximum temperatures and relevant standard edition must be confirmed by a qualified engineer
Current RMS trace is assumed piecewise-linear between samples; waveform/DC offset/limiting effects are NOT inferred
Documented I²t must be for the same physical conductor and entire clearing interval; device trip time and let-through are NOT calculated
Adiabatic only: no non-adiabatic corrections, adjacent heating, cable joints/terminations or sheath/armour stress
Passing this screen is not cable sizing, installation compliance, or protective-device approval
